name: Prefix Rank for Compact Child Indexing
definition: Counts the number of active children (bits set to 1) in a bitmask that precede a given child_index. Used to map a child index to a compact payload index in sparse octrees.
summary: Prefix Rank maps a child's logical index to its compact position in a payload array using bitwise operations on an active-child bitmask, avoiding auxiliary storage for sparse voxel grids.
